headline: Let's make something people watch twice.
intro: Melbourne lifestyle creator, mortgage broker and founder. Brands come for the content, clients come for the clarity. Here's how we can work together.
audience: Mostly 25 to 40, Melbourne and wider Australia, with a strong Indian-Australian community. Interested in travel, food, lifestyle and getting smarter with money. Audience numbers to be confirmed with Jagriti.

formats.name: UGC video
formats.front: A vertical video made for your brand, ready to post or run as an ad.
formats.back: Concept, filming, edit and usage rights agreed up front.

formats.name: Reel feature
formats.front: Your product or place, shown to her audience in her own voice.
formats.back: Posted on the channel that fits your brand best.

formats.name: Ongoing partner
formats.front: A longer run of content across channels, with room to grow the idea.
formats.back: Built around your goals, with a plan for each month.

process.title: Say hello
process.text: Send a short note about your brand and what you have in mind.

process.title: Shape the idea
process.text: We agree the concept, deliverables, timing and usage rights.

process.title: Shoot and edit
process.text: Jagriti creates the content, with a review round before anything goes live.

process.title: Go live
process.text: Content is posted or delivered, and you get the results that matter to you.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book?
faqs.a: Two to four weeks is ideal for most content. Get in touch sooner for launches or travel shoots.

faqs.q: Can we use the content in ads?
faqs.a: Yes. Usage rights, including paid ads, are agreed up front as part of the brief.

faqs.q: Do you work with brands outside Melbourne?
faqs.a: Yes. Products can be sent to Melbourne, and travel shoots can be arranged.

faqs.q: Do you work with finance brands?
faqs.a: Because Jagriti is a mortgage broker, finance-related partnerships are considered case by case to avoid any conflict of interest.
